column4: Kernel pulses event via KePulseEvent then writes pre-pulse state (v10 init=0) to out-param. Sogen writes e->signaled before clearing to false — correct; event always ends unsignaled.
Kernel checks type byte != 0 (SynchronizationEvent=1); else returns STATUS_OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH (-1073741788). Sogen checks e->type != SynchronizationEvent → STATUS_OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH. Correct.

Kernel: class 0→size must be 8; class 1→size must be 16; class>1→STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS. Sogen validates info_class>1 then size mismatch with correct per-class expected sizes. Both info classes implemented. Fix is present.

Kernel: only class 0 valid (else STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS), then exact size==8 (else STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH). Sogen: same order and values. Output fields: CurrentCount at +0, MaximumCount at +4. Correct.

Kernel: class!=0 → STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS, size!=16 → STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH. Output: DueTime (QWORD) at a3+0, TimerState (BYTE) at a3+8. Sogen writes LARGE_INTEGER at offset 0 and BOOLEAN at offset sizeof(LARGE_INTEGER)=8. Correct.
Kernel checks release_count<=0 first (a2 is signed int). Sogen casts release_count to LONG for the comparison. Correct — fix is present and placement before handle lookup matches kernel.

Kernel returns 3221225716 (STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_6) when period<0. Sogen returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER (0xC000000D). Different sub-codes but both are rejection; behaviorally equivalent for user-mode callers checking failure. Fix is present (period check before handle use).
Kernel dispatches to ExpSetTimer2 when parameters non-null; returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER when null. Sogen: if (!parameters) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. Correct.
Kernel rejects number_of_parameters>5 with STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. Sogen check is identical. Fix is present.

Kernel validates event_type via unsigned comparison against SynchronizationEvent(1). Sogen: if (event_type > SynchronizationEvent) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. Correct. 3221225485=STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.
Kernel rejects maximum_count<=0, initial_count<0, or initial_count>maximum_count. Sogen implements identical three-way check. Correct.
Kernel opens by handle. Sogen opens by name scan — functionally adequate for emulation; returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on miss. Consistent with emulator's handle model.
Kernel opens by handle; sogen opens by name with well-known event name stubs. Consistent with emulator model.
Kernel sets event signaled and releases waiters. Sogen sets entry->signaled=true. Correct for the no-waiter emulated case.
Kernel clears event. Sogen sets signaled=false. Correct.
Kernel: only EventBasicInformation (class 0), exact size==8. Sogen validates class==0 then size==sizeof(EVENT_BASIC_INFORMATION)==8 with static_assert. Correct.
Kernel rejects reserved!=0 with STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_4. Sogen: if (reserved != 0) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. Correct.
Kernel opens by handle. Sogen opens by name scan — consistent with emulator model.
Kernel initializes mutant with initial_owner. Sogen calls mutant::try_lock when initial_owner set. Correct.
Kernel opens by handle. Sogen opens by name scan — consistent with emulator model.
Kernel releases via KeReleaseMutantEx; returns STATUS_MUTANT_NOT_OWNED on failure. Sogen delegates to mutant::release checking owning_thread_id. Correct.
Kernel validates timer_type<=1 before proceeding. Sogen: if (timer_type > 1) return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER. Correct. 3221225714=STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER_4.
Kernel opens timer by handle. Sogen opens by name with proper null-checks on object_attributes and ObjectName. Consistent with emulator model.

Kernel validates attributes via ExpExTimerAttributesAreValid. Sogen stubs creation without attribute validation — acceptable for emulation since IR-timer semantics are not emulated. No visible user-mode breakage expected.
Kernel delegates to ExpSetTimer2. Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS — stub. Functionally adequate as timers are not running in emulation.
